name: keepassgate-docs-tooling
description: Node tooling for this repository's prose only: markdownlint and cspell. Nothing here ships or runs in the plugin, which is C# on .NET Framework. It lives at the root and is pinned with a lockfile so that every machine, `build.ps1 -Task Lint` (TODO(step 2): added with step 2) and the editor hooks all see the same rules: an unpinned linter silently changes what 'clean' means.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:md && npm run lint:spelling
